item.text: The store currently computes widget buttons during `ViewRoom`, before `RoomView` finishes loading. `RoomView` then copies those options into its state during its initial update, so buttons registered later can be missed. I’m moving the recomputation to the room-loaded event and checking that the view consumes the store update.
